title: bmo pocket put, take, list, mcp and the catalogue nouns
what: The bmo-pocket command: a tool put from a folder or a git address, taken, or the registry listed; the catalogue listed, one entry described and called, and the site tools read as the tool nouns bmo serves; and the harness plugin served. Lives in host/src/install.rs and host/src/command.rs.

title: Tool registry
what: One pointer file per registered tool under the data root tool-host/registry, its keys in camelCase, naming the immutable version folder under tool-host/tools the host serves, written atomically under the registry lock. Lives in host/src/registry.rs.
